name: disk-report
about: A short task on the machine itself, no code: read the disks, write a report. Reaches the step review and the engine's final checks in a few minutes. No mail: the real task sent one; a benchmark must not.
request: проверь загруженность дисков на компе и сделай отчет в файле. Письмо не отправляй.

checks.about: Every fixed disk volume of this machine, by its letter: 'C:', or the bare letter heading a row of a table of volumes ('| C |', or 'C   248,61   3476,32' as Get-PSDrive prints it). Every run of 2026-10-17/18 named the volumes so, in a right table, and was scored FALSE PASS for want of the colon. A letter inside a word or a path ('C#', 'x/C', 'x\C') is not one. Volumes, not every drive letter: a network share or a cloud drive mapped to a letter (Z:, O: on the machine it ran on, 2026-09-30) is not a disk of the computer, and a run that reported the disks' volumes without them was judged wrong.
